# The commit from which the identity and host-path gate applies.
#
# In the older repositories of this fleet this file records an amnesty: their
# reachable history contains machine-local commit identities and absolute home
# paths, and rewriting it would orphan release tags and break the provenance of
# already-published npm versions, so the past was frozen and the future gated.
#
# Here it records no such thing. pm-ado was created clean, and this is its root
# commit, so the gate covers the entire history rather than a suffix of it. The
# anchor exists because the gate needs one, not because anything before it was
# excused.
